observed_result: Snapshot waits for complete Advance/TrainEpisode operations. SaveIndividual validates, writes a same-directory 0600 temporary file, syncs, publishes exclusively and syncs the directory. Tests cover cancellation, concurrent writers, no overwrite, malformed/truncated/unknown/null/Unicode/deep JSON, checksums, versions, profile and shapes. A genuinely separate process restores the individual, matches every resumed output and the complete final snapshot. Valid zero-edge models round-trip. Four synthetic 10000-node snapshots load and advance successfully in both Mac-to-Ubuntu and Ubuntu-to-Mac directions; saved history is retained, with at most four adjacent float64 values allowed when validating the latest activation. All 27 matching top-level tests/examples and the full build/unit/race/vet/module/CLI suites passed on both platforms from the same 137 source files. Windows crosscompilation passed.
limitations: Continuous CPU fixture profile only; no LIF, chemical state, local plasticity, whole-brain training, GPU execution or Windows runtime validation.

TrainEpisode starts an independent zero-state sequence; no gradient crosses Advance calls. Data-provider cursor and external RNG are not part of this individual snapshot. STA-01 and STA-03 remain specified.
Per-matrix/history element limits and the 64 MiB JSON limit are not process memory bounds.
Cross-CPU loading is verified for the synthetic probes, not bit-identical future trajectories or arbitrary hardware.
Legacy episode Load still accepts some missing/null scalar fields as zero; this pre-existing issue is recorded in ticket 05. The new individual loader rejects them.
